kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi add-short-url --source-url https://www.0000.com/product/sms --short-url-name '阿里短链测试' --effective-days 7 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddShortUrl

parameters.help_en:
The URL that you want to shorten. Maximum length: 1,000 characters.

><notice>

Short Message Service does not currently support this API operation.

></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
原始链接地址。不超过1000个字符。
><notice>短信服务暂时不支持使用此接口。></notice>
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.help_en: The name of the short URL. Maximum length: 13 characters
parameters.help_zh: 短链服务名称。不超过13个字符
parameters.name: short_url_name

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the short URL, in days. The maximum value is 90
parameters.help_zh: 短链服务使用有效期。单位为天，有效期最长为90天
parameters.name: effective_days
